issue.title: Persist artifact references on beads and ChangeSpecs
issue.description: A bead and a ChangeSpec each carry a durable, ordered list of canonical artifact references that survives machines, workspaces, and store rebuilds: one shared Rust codec parses, normalizes, and batch-resolves reference lists for every caller; `sase bead ref` and `sase changespec ref` attach and detach them; `sase bead show`, the ACE surfaces, bead pages, and the mobile bridge render the stable reference and where it currently resolves; and `sase bead doctor` and `sase doctor` report references that resolve nowhere instead of silently passing.

issue.title: Shared reference-list codec and the ChangeSpec REFS section
issue.description: core-refs: add the Rust parse/normalize/render/batch-resolve API for stored artifact-reference lists, expose it through the PyO3 binding, and teach the Rust ChangeSpec parser the new REFS section behind a wire-schema bump.

issue.title: The bead refs field in the Rust core
issue.description: core-beads: give beads a `refs` list with its own add and remove events, SQLite column and migration, JSONL codec, `sase bead ref` and `sase bead create --ref` handling, show rendering, search coverage, and doctor diagnostics.

issue.title: Python bead refs, show, and doctor
issue.description: beads: raise the core floor, add the Python reference-list facade, mirror the new bead field across the model, codecs, and JSON wire, render a resolved REFS section in `sase bead show`, and thread the reference context into `sase bead doctor`.

issue.title: The ChangeSpec REFS section in Python, CLI, and ACE
issue.description: changespecs: parse, format, and atomically persist the REFS section in Python, consolidate the duplicated section-boundary tables onto one constant, add `sase changespec ref`, render REFS in the ACE CLI and TUI, and add the `sase doctor` validation check.

issue.title: Published pages, ACE Plans tab, mobile bridge, and declaration
issue.description: surfaces: render bead references on published pages and in the ACE Plans detail panel, return them through the mobile bridge, and let `sase artifact create` attach the reference it just minted to a bead.

issue.title: Documentation, skills, and the live-store audit
issue.description: docs: document the bead field and the ChangeSpec section, update the affected skill sources, regenerate the deployed skills, and audit both live stores with the new validators.
